#!/bin/sh
set -e

echo "Starting schedule loop..."

while true; do
    # Wait until the start of the next minute
    sleep $((60 - $(date +%S)))

    # Run the scheduler
    frankenphp php-cli artisan schedule:run
done
# Wait until the start of the next minute
